assertions.name: phi8_first_at_M_le_7_for_D_minus_n
assertions.source: PR #1618 mechanism doc Test 3 prefix-sum table.

description: Δa_m partial-sum cyclotomic scan: for each atomic-step pair (D−n), (³He−D), (⁴He−³He), compute S_M = Σ_{m=0..M} Δa_m·(u;u)_m for M = 0..M_max as polynomials over ℤ[u], factor each S_M, record the multiplicity of Φ_8(u) = u^4 + 1 in S_M, and identify the smallest M for which Φ_8 (resp. Φ_8²) first divides S_M. At the M_first_Φ_8 boundary, compute Q(u) = S_M/(u^4+1) and isolate the interference between Σ_prev and the marginal Δa_M·(u;u)_M that produces the new (u^4+1) factor. Cross-pair comparison reveals whether M_first_Φ_8 is pair-invariant or pair-dependent.

data.verdict: Φ_8 pair-invariant, Φ_8² pair-dependent — single-cyclotomic interference is universal at fixed depth, but Φ_8² depth varies with helium-vs-deuteron complexity
